question: How large and direction-specific are the finite decision-score effects of the fixed native groups that caused zero program flips?
selection: All six groups copied exactly from closed N20 selection; no recomputation, fitting or new selection.
case_scope: All thirteen closed role cases, same prompts and original prefix tokens. Eight discovery and five other development cases are reported separately; neither is fresh confirmation. No completed continuation is generated or regraded. Retention/program outcomes remain the closed N20 results, not new N24 successes.
edits: Exactly the existing native post-gating h policies at current cached decision. Conditional cut applies all-35-layer opposite states first, then actual recipient group values. No attention/KV/weight edit or extra branch. Remove hooks before any other call.
guards: Replay all 525 native h hashes for the fifteen source trajectories, plus exact current full-logit and whole-cache witnesses from N20.
Full self reproduces native logits/cache. Full opposite and full same-policy reproduce exact N20 current logits/cache for all thirteen cases.
Every new group-operation current-logit hash and argmax matches its corresponding closed N20 prediction. No tolerance amendment or old continuation regeneration.
Each native group self reproduces native whole logits/cache; each conditional group self reproduces the live full-opposite background whole logits/cache.
All group edits lie in layers 24 to 34: clean edits preserve native whole cache byte-exact; conditional cuts preserve the full-opposite whole cache byte-exact.
Two native restoration sentinels after every group-operation block and each of the three parent blocks; two more after the complete self-guard phase.
Original parameter versions, gradient flags, p.grad None and hooks remain unchanged. Reject malformed or truncated cache; actual pinned layout has fifteen entries.
metric_precision: Compute compact metrics in CPU FP64 from the actual BF16 logits converted to FP32. This is not FP64 model inference or unrounded reconstruction. Full vectors are ephemeral and never saved.
primary_estimands: Per case m = logit(opposite next token) - logit(own next token). For each group and operation report m_edited - m_native and the two component logits.

For conditional cuts also report m_full_opposite - m_cut. Full-opposite minus native margin is the fixed positive-control scale; report raw values and the ratio, with any zero/nonpositive denominator flagged instead of silently excluded.
For selected64 opposite donors, report its mean finite margin shift minus each matched random64 shift, with raw per-case pairs. Report nested16 separately; it cannot replace selected64.

Report all thirteen means, medians, ranges and sign counts; both task-family means; all mapping/label/wording/direction strata. Report the eight discovery and five other development cases separately. No independent-algorithm p-value or confirmed-role pass/fail claim.
secondary_estimands: For every measured state save own/opposite log probabilities, logsumexp, top1 and deterministic top8 token IDs/logits with lower token ID resolving ties.

Relative to native logits, report maximum absolute change, L2 norm, centered L2 norm, vocabulary RMS and KL(native||edited) in FP64. Also report each operator logit shift and margin shift divided by vocabulary RMS when nonzero, flagging zero separately. These describe output selectivity; they do not prove semantics.

On exactly the eight N19 discovery cases, compare per-stratum finite opposite-margin means with sums of archived FP32 stratum_score entries for each fixed group. Each stratum averages two families. Report signed differences and ratios only with nonzero denominators. No new gradients, individual-case prediction reconstruction or unrounded-precision claim.
Keep existing N20 program flips/losses and N21 utility failures explicit. Continuous effects cannot replace those outcomes.
counter_contract: Every source, parent, self, edit and restoration uses a fresh cache. For prompt length n and prefix length k: k+1 root forwards and n+k input-token exposures. Derive totals from the exact 578-row prospective trajectory manifest; no hand-summed constant and no generation loop.
host_gates: Before GPU: independent metric fixtures including additive logit shift, identity, extreme logits and tie order; actual tiny-Gemma current/group/conditional/self/rescue/restoration/cache paths; both runner/auditor isolated imports; Ruff F821/F823; exact tokenization and all packaged cells/sources. Do not rerun closed scorers or unchanged old fixtures.
outputs: Compact metrics, hashes, native scalar source witnesses, edit receipts and trajectory counters only. No full logits, hidden activations, base weights, raw answers or fitted tensors in public or Kaggle outputs.
stopping: Any guard failure stops interpretation. Preserve partials and failures. No changed tolerance, new dose/group, prompt rewrite or tail regeneration. Finite effects absent, positive or negative are all reported. No claimed semantic role or useful coding benefit from this reused token-level study.
